name: Munakata Chiharu
source:
Likes: Teasing and observing [url=/c35512]Seiji[/url]
Dislikes: Nothing in particular

The senpai everybody adores and admires, she was the last year's festival's male god. In fact, she is so popular that she has a dedicated fanclub. Due to her experience (she is also sexually knowledgeable, despite not having any experience herself), she is the girl who can help Seiji the most. Chiharu knows the ins-and-outs of males due to her little brother, who she used as a test subject more than dozens of times. She is also happy how her cup size has changed from A to G this year. Maybe it was due to the fact that she was the male god and was really blessed last year.
